start_here: Say to your AI: "List the lessons I hold in my courses." It reads the courses your access opens and answers each lesson with its title, its video link and whether it has a transcript.
no_lists_because: The lessons are the school's own rows, read through the engine each time; the person keeps no list of their own for this job.
instructions: 1. Give your AI the engine connection it already uses for your account; the school's coach must be set up for the school first.
2. Say "List the lessons I hold in my courses."
3. Read the answer: each course with its lessons, and for each lesson the video link and whether a transcript exists. Ask for one lesson by its id to read it.

worked_examples.title: A learner who holds one course sees its lessons
worked_examples.ask: List the lessons I hold in my courses.
worked_examples.hands_back: One course, "Alpha course", with 3 lessons: lesson-1 "Accepting Invariants" (video link, transcript yes), lesson-2 "North Star talk" (no video, transcript no), lesson-3 "Racket grip drill" (video link, transcript yes).
